en: A colored vintage postcard view of a large open square bordered by buildings and green areas, with a circular monument or statue in the foreground-left and people walking around the plaza. Snow-capped mountains and rocky hills rise in the background. The caption at the top left reads "Trento. Piazza Dante." indicating the scene is Piazza Dante in Trento, Italy.
